title: TechKnow Orientation Quiz 2026
description: Fast-paced orientation quiz covering reality checks, club info, and executive crisis simulation.

questions.text: You convince your parents you absolutely need a high-end, ₹1 Lakh gaming laptop for your "engineering coursework." In reality, what is the most intensive task that laptop will handle in your first semester?
options: Training complex AI models.
Running heavy 3D rendering software.
Having 40 Chrome tabs open while playing games in the back row.
Compiling an operating system from scratch.

questions.text: You use an AI tool to speed up writing a formal email to your professor. What is the worst possible phrase you can accidentally leave in the text before hitting send?
options: "Best regards,"
"As an AI language model, I suggest..."
"Sent from my iPhone"
"Please find attached"

questions.text: The exact moment you tell your extended family that you have joined a technical institute, what becomes your unofficial new job title at family gatherings?
options: The Future CEO.
The person who fixes everyone's Wi-Fi router and phone storage.
The Investment Advisor.
The Software Architect.

questions.text: You are assigned to a random 4-person group for your very first college presentation. Statistically speaking, how is the work actually going to be divided?
options: Everyone contributes exactly 25%.
Two people research, two people present.
Exactly one person does the entire project while the other three nod in agreement.
The professor does it for you.

questions.text: We just showed you our digital footprint. What is the official website URL of the TechKnow Society?
options: techknow.tech
techknowcouncil.com
iiitkota.tech
codebase.in

questions.text: If you want to learn how to identify security vulnerabilities and explore ethical hacking, which club should you join?
options: Cyph3r
The IT Support Desk
Codebase
ARC Robotics

questions.text: Codebase organizes HackTheChain, the biggest hackathon in the city. What was the total prize pool we just presented?
options: ₹1 Lakh
1.6 Lakh Rupees
₹2 Lakhs

questions.text: According to the TechKnow hierarchy shown on screen, which of these is an actual top-level Manager position?
options: Operations Manager
Treasurer
Content Executive
Chief of Staff

questions.text: Which club is officially described as the place where "innovation meets engineering" to design, build, and program machines?
options: GDG
IIIT Kernel
ARC Robotics
Cyph3r

questions.text: The Chief Guest is 45 minutes late, the stage mic just died, and the crowd of 500 is starting to get restless. What is your first move?
options: Wait backstage and hope the mic fixes itself.
Tell the crowd there is a technical delay and ask them to wait silently.
Instantly push an interactive crowd game to the stage to keep them engaged, while silently sending one person to fix the mic.
Cancel the first 30 minutes of the show.

questions.text: A food vendor from last year refuses to pay our ₹5,000 sponsorship fee because they claim there was too much competition last time and they lost money. How do you secure their funds?
options: Ask them for a smaller donation out of goodwill.
Guarantee them a "monopoly" by allowing only two stalls on campus, and charge a ₹3,000 advance deposit to lock their spot.
Argue with them about the footfall numbers.
Offer to put their logo on the main stage for free.

questions.text: It’s 5 minutes before HackTheChain starts, and the primary coding platform completely crashes. What is your protocol?
options: Refresh the page repeatedly and wait.
Send a message saying the server is down and to try again later.
Shift the event to tomorrow.
Post an official update on the communication channels instantly, extend the timer, and prepare a backup link.

questions.text: The Event team urgently needs a ₹15,000 sound system, but the official college Note Sheet only approved ₹8,000. The event is tomorrow. What do you do?
options: Tell the Event team to cut their requirements in half.
Negotiate a barter deal: Offer the vendor exclusive "Official Sound Partner" branding on the main screen in exchange for a ₹7,000 discount.
Ask the council members to pay the difference out of pocket.
Use a standard Bluetooth speaker instead.

questions.text: Two of your Senior Executives are arguing backstage over whose job it is to handle sponsor check-ins. The sponsors arrive in 3 minutes. What is the call?
options: Assign them completely separate zones immediately to protect the event timeline, and deal with the conflict tomorrow.
Mediate the argument right there until they agree.
Do the check-ins yourself to avoid drama.
Tell them both to leave the backstage area.

questions.text: You pitch a GATE coaching center for sponsorship. They say, "Your college footfall is too small, we only sponsor fests with 10,000+ crowds." How do you win them over?
options: Offer them an 80% discount on the sponsorship package.
Tell them we don't have 10,000 randoms, we have a highly concentrated room of dedicated engineering students—which is their exact target demographic.
Agree with them and look for smaller sponsors.
Promise them we will make attendance mandatory for all students.
